title: How to make a pixel reel

scenes.title: Your own reel
scenes.caption: One box. One button.
scenes.say: Want a pixel reel of your own? It takes one box, and one button. Here's how.

scenes.title: My notes
scenes.caption: Type in My notes. Or press Speak, and talk.
scenes.say: See My notes, right beside me? Type in it. Or press Speak, and just say it out loud.

scenes.title: Anything
scenes.caption: A link, a meeting transcript, a question.
scenes.say: Put in anything. Paste a link to a page. The transcript of a meeting. Or a question you have always wondered about.

scenes.title: Make it
scenes.caption: Press Make my next reel.
scenes.say: Then press Make my next reel. Claude writes it, I read it out, and it plays in about a minute.

scenes.title: Keep asking
scenes.caption: Every reel has My notes too.
scenes.say: Every reel you make has My notes beside it too. Ask more, and your next reel carries on from there.

scenes.title: Try one
scenes.caption: Not sure? Try one of these.
scenes.say: Not sure where to start? Try one of these. Why do cats knead blankets? Or, how does a plane stay up?
